subject: Problems with fonts in spectra plots

messages.author: 76b8a30eac910718
messages.subject: Problems with fonts in spectra plots
parts:
Dear colleagues:
I have a problem generating sound spectra using the R seewave library. When I increase the size of the letters as the referees ask me, I can't get the titles to adapt to the rest of the graph. I tried with ggspectro and with several options and I don't get anything. The instruction I use is this:
espectro<-spectro(a, wl=1024, ovlp=60, oma=rep(0,4), zp=16, collevels=seq(-40,0,0.5), scalefontlab=4, flim=c(0,15),cexlab=3,scalecexlab=3,scale=TRUE)
Some suggestion?.
Thank you very much in advance
--
